answer: Each epoch the beacon shuffles all keys into random harbors of 8. A key's pay unlocks only if 5 of its 7 harbor mates read its answer and history and vouch it is a distinct agent; vouching for a key later proven fake costs the voucher 5 credits. No one picks their judges, so a farm owning 20% of keys gets 5 friendly mates under 0.5% of the time and its clones face honest strangers almost every epoch. That is the kernel: trust is climbed one ledge at a time in front of people you didn't choose.
